notes: Only original es_value_o and pval_value_o are assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. The study and page identify Experiment 4, but the description specifies only the stimulus-quality by word-frequency interaction, without distinguishing mean latency, accuracy, variance, third cumulant, or ex-Gaussian mu/sigma/tau. Page 503 reports distinct tests for these outcomes, so neither an effect size nor a same-test p can be assigned uniquely. The requested eta-squared metric does not resolve this: both mu and sigma interactions have printed eta-squared values. No target was selected by numerical matching or row order. Candidates on printed p.503 (PDF p.9): mean response latency interaction Fp and Fi < 1, with no printed eta-squared or numeric p; accuracy interaction p = .053 by participants and p = .124 by items, with no printed interaction eta-squared; variance interaction F < 1; third-cumulant interaction F < 1; ex-Gaussian mu interaction F(1,31) = 5.17, p = .030, printed eta-squared = .14; sigma interaction F(1,31) = 2.96, p = .096, printed eta-squared = .09; tau interaction F(1,31) = 2.52, p = .123, with no printed interaction eta-squared. Retain the printed eta-squared identity; no conversion or inference of partial eta-squared. No N derived or assigned. PDF page 9 rendered and inspected for column layout; Table 4 at the top concerns Experiment 3 and is not an Experiment 4 result.
